name: dashboard-widget
purpose: Enhances a host element in place into a titled dashboard panel (widget container, collapsible widget, dashboard tile): a header with a heading (level 2-6), optional subtitle, and action buttons (custom icon actions, collapse, maximize, remove) is inserted as the host's first child; the host's other children are the body and are never moved. The host is a region labelled by the title. Collapse is a disclosure button (aria-expanded) that hides the body. Maximize shows the widget in the top layer through the Popover API as a modal dialog (role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trapped, page scroll locked; Escape or the restore button restores). Remove emits a cancelable aui-remove; the application removes the widget or its grid item.
whenToUse: Panels inside a Dashboard Grid (pass data-aui-item on the host).
Titled content blocks on a dashboard that users collapse, expand to full screen, or remove.
whenNotToUse: Generic content cards without widget actions: use Card.
Dialogs opened from elsewhere on the page: use Dialog.
Page sections that should not be landmarks: the host becomes role=region unless it already has another role.
responsive: Fills its container (a grid cell inside Dashboard Grid) and scrolls its content (overflow: auto). Header actions wrap. Maximized, the widget is fixed over the viewport inset by space-6. Action buttons are touch-target-min squares. Inside an editing Dashboard Grid the header leaves room for the move handle.
rtl: Logical properties throughout. The collapsed chevron rotates toward the inline start (mirrored in RTL). Header actions follow the inline direction.
theme: color-surface, color-border, radius-lg, and shadow-sm for the panel; shadow-lg and a color-backdrop ::backdrop when maximized; color-hover and a focus-ring-width outline on actions. Forced-colors mode draws a CanvasText border. The chevron transition is removed under reduced motion.
security: Title, subtitle, and action labels are rendered with textContent and attributes. Body content is the consumer's and is never read, moved, or re-parsed. No HTML sinks; CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. Collapsed and maximized state are reported through aui-toggle and aui-maximize; the application stores them if needed.

budgets.budget: Not separately budgeted; covered by the Dashboard Grid create budget (50 items < 40 ms in headless Chromium, e2e performance test)

performance.testedScale: Behavior unit tests with single widgets; dashboards of 50 widgets are the Dashboard Grid target.

limitations: Maximize relies on the Popover API for the top layer; without HTMLElement.showPopover the widget is only fixed-positioned (it may sit under other stacked content).
The collapse button has no aria-controls: the body is every host child except the header.
headingLevel cannot change after create (recreate the widget).
The remove event has no default action: the widget stays until the application removes it.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
unsupported: Rendering HTML in the title or subtitle.
Drag handles inside the widget (Dashboard Grid adds the move handle in edit mode).
antiPatterns: Duplicate titles on one dashboard: region and action names ('Collapse {title}', 'Remove {title}') become ambiguous.
Hiding critical content in a collapsed widget by default without telling users.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/dashboard-widget: hand-written AuiDashboardWidget directive ([auiDashboardWidget], enhances the host in place; inputs mirror the options; outputs auiToggle, auiMaximize, auiAction, auiRemove).
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/dashboard-widget: hand-written AuiDashboardWidget; renders a <section> with the children as the body; props = DashboardWidgetOptions + onToggle, onMaximize, onAction, onRemove (detail); ref receives the DashboardWidget.
adapters.vue: @absoluteui/vue/dashboard-widget: AuiDashboardWidget (renders a <section>; default slot is the body; emits toggle, maximize, action, remove; template ref exposes controller).
